01-wave-hello: Standing facing the viewer, one gloved hand raised high and waving hello with a few short motion lines beside it, the other hand relaxed at its side, big friendly open smile, happy eyes. A warm welcoming pose for an opening slide.
02-wai-greeting: Doing the traditional Thai wai greeting: standing with feet together, both white-gloved palms pressed flat together in front of its chest with fingertips pointing up, body bowed slightly forward, eyes closed in a gentle, grateful smile. Polite, respectful and warm.
03-holding-sign: Standing and holding up a large blank rectangular sign board above its head with both hands, excited open-mouthed smile. The sign is completely empty: plain white fill with a thick black outline and nothing written or drawn on it.
04-agenda-checklist: Holding a bright blue clipboard in one hand at chest height, turned toward the viewer, showing a white checklist of three rows; each row is a small box with a bold black check mark followed by a thick short black line instead of words. The other hand holds a big yellow pencil as if it just ticked the last box. Focused, confident smile.
05-thinking: Thinking pose: one gloved hand touching its chin, the other arm folded across its body supporting that elbow, eyes glancing up and to the side, mouth pursed in a small puzzled shape. Three small bright blue question marks float above its head.
06-idea-lightbulb: Eureka moment: springing up on its toes with one index finger pointing straight up, eyes wide, huge excited open-mouthed smile. A big glowing yellow light bulb with a black outline and short bold burst lines floats just above its head.
07-magnifying-glass: Investigating like a detective: leaning forward and holding a big magnifying glass with a bright blue rim and handle up to one eye; that eye looks huge and curious through the lens. The other hand rests on its hip.
08-ai-robot-highfive: Giving an enthusiastic high-five to a small, cute, friendly robot sidekick about half its height: a rounded white robot with bright blue accents, a square head, a short antenna with a ball on top, and simple black dot eyes with a smile. Both are smiling, and a small burst of star sparks pops where their hands meet. Both characters fully visible.
09-megaphone: Leaning forward energetically and shouting into a bright blue-and-white megaphone held with both hands, mouth wide open, bold curved sound-wave lines bursting out of the megaphone's bell. A call-to-action pose.
10-rocket-launch: Riding on top of a small white cartoon rocket with bright blue fins and a round window, blasting off diagonally up toward the upper right. One hand holds on to the rocket, the other fist punches the air, huge thrilled grin. Puffy white exhaust clouds with black outlines and a yellow flame trail behind the rocket.
11-goal-flag: Standing triumphantly on the top of a small stylized mountain peak (bright blue mountain with a white snowcap and bold black outline), planting a plain yellow flag on a pole with one hand, the other hand on its hip, proud confident smile. The flag has no symbol or text.
12-trophy: Lifting a big shiny yellow trophy cup high above its head with both hands, eyes squeezed shut in joy, huge open-mouthed smile, small sparkle stars around the trophy. The trophy has no text or engraving.
13-celebrate-jump: Jumping high into the air in celebration with both arms thrown up, knees bent and sneakers kicked up behind, ecstatic open-mouthed grin, eyes happily closed, surrounded by flat confetti pieces and streamers in yellow, blue and black.
14-coffee-break: Taking a relaxing break: sitting comfortably on a squishy bright blue beanbag chair, legs crossed, holding a plain white coffee mug with curly steam lines in both hands, eyes contentedly closed, peaceful small smile.
15-qa-microphone: Q&A time: holding a black handheld microphone near its mouth with one hand and speaking, the other hand raised with open palm as if inviting a question from the audience, friendly engaged expression. Two small empty speech-bubble outlines float beside its head with nothing inside them.
16-peek-from-bottom: Peeking up from below: only the upper half of the character is visible (its cap, big curious eyes and the top of its body) rising above a straight horizontal cut-off at the very bottom edge of the image, with both white-gloved hands gripping that bottom edge on either side. Cheeky, curious expression, as if peeking over the bottom of a slide.
17-thumbs-up: Confident double thumbs-up with both white-gloved hands held forward, winking one eye, big cheeky grin, standing with one sneaker stepped slightly forward.
18-point-right: Excitedly pointing with both index fingers toward the right side of the image, body turned three-quarters toward the right, bright smile, as if directing the audience's attention to content beside it. No other objects.
